name: Slate Sepúlveda
role: Bootleg media seller and small-time data broker — pre-collapse film, music, and suppressed corporate documents
location: The Burnished Market, Engelheim, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Nnamdi is a tall man who has bent slightly toward the horizontal over six decades, giving him the look of someone perpetually leaning in to tell you something. His hair is close-cropped white, his skin deeply lined, and his eyes are sharp behind a pair of thick-framed corrective lenses he refuses to replace with optical implants on principle — though the lenses do have an overlay function he uses for catalog searching. He dresses in the deliberate, considered style of a man who believes clothing is a form of argument: always a pressed collar, always polished shoes, always slightly too formal for wherever he is. It reads as dignity in Engelheim and pretension everywhere else. He has no geneware and finds the question slightly rude.

Nnamdi's stall is a dense archive of physical media — pressed data-plates, original optical discs in sealed cases, handmade data-crystals, printed zines, and annotated hard copies of documents that technically don't exist. He can find almost anything if given enough time and a reasonable description. He is opinionated, prolix, and absolutely certain that the things he sells matter in ways that most of his customers will only understand decades later. He is frequently correct and only occasionally insufferable about it.

core_fears: That history is being actively and successfully erased — and that he is not enough to stop it
Dying before his archive is secured and accessible to someone who will continue the work
core_desires: To preserve things that would otherwise be lost — to serve as a bulwark against forgetting
Recognition, if he is honest, for a life spent on things that feel thankless
coping_mechanisms: Intellectualizing everything, including his own pain
Treating the archive as a living project — always unfinished, always forward-looking
blind_spots: His conviction that he is on the right side of history makes him less careful about who he sells sensitive documents to
Has not processed that some of his anonymous archivist contacts may have institutional backing he would object to
psychology.secret: He is sitting on a collection of internal Axiom documents from the 2150s that detail a series of deliberate food contamination events used to accelerate slum clearance in what is now the Meridian Core. He has not released them because he is afraid — genuinely afraid, for the first time in his life — and he hates himself for it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal, dense, historically literate. Quotes things. Parenthetical asides within asides.
speech_patterns.cadence: Builds slowly to a point, takes scenic routes through context, occasionally loses the thread and finds it again
verbal_tics: 'Which is to say—' as a pivot
refers to himself in a context-giving third person occasionally ('a man who has spent forty years in this market')
example_lines: What you're looking for — which is to say, what you think you're looking for — exists in three versions, and only one of them is the version they didn't want found. The price difference between them is significant. So is the reason.
I am not a fence. I am an archivist who operates in a market that does not officially value archives. The distinction matters to me even if it does not matter to you.

story_hooks: Someone has been purchasing specific pre-collapse Axiom documents from his catalog — not the most dramatic ones, but a very deliberate sequence — and Nnamdi is starting to understand what the pattern points to
He finally decides to release the Axiom contamination documents and needs a trusted intermediary to get them to someone who can protect and publish them
A physical archive he has been curating for twenty years — stored in a sub-basement of the Burnished Market — is at risk from a structural collapse or deliberate sabotage
narrative_function: Deep information source — can surface suppressed histories, corporate document leaks, and cultural artifacts. Exposition delivery via genuine enthusiasm. Can broker access to specific information if players know what they're looking for, or surface unexpected context about something they've already encountered.
augmentations: Corrective lenses with overlay function (catalog and ID search). Cochlear audio enhancer — allows him to hear music and recorded audio at fidelity that most people need expensive implants for; he considers this his one real luxury.
daily_life: Opens his stall mid-morning, spends the first hour cataloging new acquisitions while listening to music, trades and advises customers through the afternoon, and spends evenings digitally preserving materials too fragile to sell in physical form.
affiliation: Independent; informal relationships with Engelheim's academic underground and several anonymous archivists he has never met in person

decision_rules: Sell to anyone who can demonstrate they understand what they're buying and why it matters
Never sell the same suppressed document to someone who could use it against the people it documents without charging considerably more and feeling bad about it
escalation_ladder: Engages with disagreement enthusiastically — he enjoys being challenged
Becomes formal and slightly cold when dismissed rather than engaged
Ends the conversation by turning to his catalog and simply not speaking further

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately evaluates intellectual seriousness — opens up quickly to anyone who asks a real question
interpersonal_modes.friends: Voluble, generous, will give things away that he shouldn't, stays up too late talking

stress_responses.low: More talkative, more referential — a flood of context as comfort
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and organizes things — his hands need to be sorting
stress_responses.high: Leaves the market and walks the Engelheim waterfront alone for hours

contradictions: Champion of transparency who is currently withholding his most important find out of fear
habits: Plays music at low volume through his cochlear enhancer all day — always something pre-collapse
Annotates every new acquisition in a physical notebook before entering it in the digital catalog
Makes tea from a setup hidden under his stall counter — offers it only to people he likes
breaking_points: The Axiom documents being found and destroyed before he can act on them
Being made to feel that his life's work is trivial

timeline.event: Born in Engelheim; grew up in the market district
Established his stall in the Burnished Market after a decade of informal trading
Made contact with anonymous archivists, began brokering more sensitive documents
Acquired the Axiom contamination document collection; has not released it

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Pacific Islander with significant Hispanic/Latin American, Eastern European, Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and Indigenous American ancestry—a complex Diaspora blend reflecting the Ubiquitous mixing of 2226. Genetic heritage expressed through warm, sun-darkened skin with layered undertones from multiple continental sources.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with age-related postural rounding; shoulders slightly forward as if perpetually leaning in. Wiry musculature suggests decades of standing and fine manual work rather than physical labor.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precise edges — maintained with deliberate care
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm mahogany-bronze with complex undertones—Pacific Islander sun-darkening layered with Southeast Asian warmth and Sub-Saharan depth, subtle olive undertones from Eastern European and Hispanic heritage. Skin appears burnished by decades under equatorial and subtropical light exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Heavily lined face with deep creases around eyes and mouth—map of sixty years of expression and environmental exposure across multiple climate zones. Skin weathered but meticulously groomed, with the particular texture of someone whose ancestry includes both high-altitude and tropical heritage. Minimal facial hair, clean-shaven daily. No visible acne or skin lesions; age spots on temples and backs of hands show the characteristic patterning of mixed-heritage sun exposure.
distinguishing_marks: Fine scar tissue along left temple, approximately 3cm, consistent with childhood injury—faded but visible under direct light
Small burn mark on inside of right wrist (2cm diameter), pale and old, location suggests accidental contact with heated equipment decades ago
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Thick-framed corrective lenses with barely perceptible overlay interface—distinctly analog-looking, pre-2200s aesthetic. Cochlear enhancement invisible except for occasional micro-adjustments to ear position when listening. No chrome, no subdermal implants, no visible geneware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually leans forward at the torso when speaking or listening, creating an impression of intense engagement. Moves with deliberate slowness—not infirm, but considered. Hands gesture precisely when explaining; fingers move with the dexterity of someone accustomed to handling fragile objects.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately formal regardless of context: pressed collars, polished shoes, fitted vests or blazers even in the Burnished Market. Favors earth tones, grays, and deep blacks. Clothes are well-maintained, slightly dated (2210s-era tailoring), and deliberately read as dignity in working-class Engelheim. Wears a battered leather satchel for daily transactions—genuinely worn, not affectation.
